title: Add the tutor point-permission assertion gamification_p1_test.dart E2E-608 Part 2 claims but never checks

evidence.quote:
'shows the permission-denied SnackBar on tap, and the point config '
          'increment button is disabled', (tester) async {

// The screen may show "no active curricula" but the Save button
        // and increment/decrement buttons are all disabled. Just assert

why: The test's own name promises to verify 'the point config increment button is disabled' for a tutor with canEditPoints=false. Part 2 of the body navigates to PointConfigScreen and asserts only the screen title ('Point Settings') — no widget query checks the `+` control's disabled state and nothing is tapped-then-verified-inert. I traced the production wiring: point_config_screen.dart:241 computes `canEdit = tutorPerms == null || tutorPerms.canEditPoints`, gates `onIncrement` at line 332 and the save bar at line 346, and `tutorPerms` comes from `activeTutorPermissionsProvider`, which derives from `activeTutoredProfileSelectionProvider` — the exact provider this test overrides with canEditPoints:false. So today's code is correct, but a future regression that flips that gate would sail through this test green despite its title's explicit claim.
recommendation: After navigating to PointConfigScreen in Part 2, assert the increment control's onPressed/onIncrement is null (or tap it and confirm no pending-edit / Save-bar-enabled state appears), matching the rigor Part 1 already applies to the Save Reward permission-denied check.
acceptance_criteria: E2E-608 Part 2 contains an explicit expect() on the increment control's disabled state, not just a screen-title check
Hard-coding point_config_screen.dart's canEdit to always-true makes this test fail
